description: This Python module provides classes and methods for integrating with the ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech (TTS) API. It includes configuration settings, parameter mapping functions, environment validation, request building, and response processing specifically tailored for ElevenLabs TTS service. It maps OpenAI TTS specifications to the ElevenLabs API and facilitates voice selection, format mapping, and request customization.

classes.name: ElevenLabsTextToSpeechConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for ElevenLabs Text-to-Speech API, including URL endpoints, voice mappings, format mappings, parameter handling, environment validation, request transformation, and response handling tailored for the ElevenLabs API.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of OpenAI parameters supported by ElevenLabs TTS API.

methods.name: str _extract_voice_id(self, voice: str)
methods.description: Normalizes a voice string into an ElevenLabs voice ID using voice mappings.

methods.name: str _resolve_voice_id( self, voice: Optional[Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]], params: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Determines the appropriate ElevenLabs voice ID given a voice input, which can be a string or dictionary, and parameters.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Dict] map_openai_params( self, model: str, optional_params: Dict, voice: Optional[Union[str, Dict]] = None, drop_params: bool = False, kwargs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI TTS parameters to ElevenLabs-specific parameters and query parameters.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets up environment headers, including API key retrieval for ElevenLabs.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, Headers] )
methods.description: Returns a specific exception class instance for ElevenLabs errors.

methods.name: TextToSpeechRequestData transform_text_to_speech_request( self, model: str, input: str, voice: Optional[str], optional_params: Dict, litellm_params: Dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Builds the payload for a TTS request to ElevenLabs API, including text, model ID, and optional parameters.

methods.name: None _add_elevenlabs_specific_params( self, mapped_voice: str, query_params: Dict[str, Any], mapped_params: Dict[str, Any], kwargs: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], remaining_params: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Adds remaining parameters, including extra_body and custom kwargs, into the mapped_params for the request.

methods.name: "HttpxBinaryResponseContent" transform_text_to_speech_response( self, model: str, raw_response: httpx.Response, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, )
methods.description: Wraps the raw HTTP response into an ElevenLabs-specific binary response content object.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for the TTS request, including voice ID and query parameters.
